analyzed: brāhmaṇa vaśīkaraṇe lāja arka samidh ghṛta aktām aṣṭa sahasram juhūyāt sarva brāhmaṇāḥ vaśyāḥ bhavanti kṣatriya vaśīkaraṇe guḍa ghṛta lāja arka patram aṣṭa sahasram juhūyāt sarva kṣatriya vaśīkaraṇam bhaviṣyati iti śūdra vaśīkaraṇe madana phala karṇikārikām aṣṭa sahasram juhūyāt sarva śūdrāṇām vaśīkaraṇam parama siddhiḥ vaiśya vasīkaraṇe trividha ghṛta aktām aṣṭa sahasram juhūyāt sarva vaiśya vaśīkaraṇam jātī

original: §15 sarvabhayapraśamane vrīhighṛtam aṣṭasahasraṃ juhūyāt sarvabhayāḥ kalikalahavigrahavivādeṣu praśamayanti. dhanadhānyapravartane saptadhānyaghṛtāktām aṣṭasahasraṃ juhūyāt. dhanadhānyavṛddhir bhaviṣyati.

analyzed: yakṣam āvāhayitu kāmena guggulu caṇḍa bījaka madhu ghṛta aktām aṣṭa sahasram juhūyāt yakṣaḥ sva rūpeṇa agratas upatiṣṭhati kiṃkara kārakaḥ sarva karmakaraḥ bhaviṣyati

original: §18 kāmarūpīm āvāhayitukāmena lājāsarṣapadadhimadhughṛtāktāṃ gandhapriyaṅgu aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt. karavīrakāṣṭhasamidbhir agni prajvālya tato kāmarūpī āgacchati. yathākāmatā cārayati. tṛbhi prakārāṇi vaktavyam. mātā bhāryā bhaginī. yadi mātā putrasnehayā mahādhanadhānyaparibhogavivṛddhiṃ saṃpādayati. yāvajjīvaṃ avaikalpatāṃ saṃtiṣṭhati. yadi bhāryā-m-anekavividharatikrīḍayā paribhogaṃ paricarati.  vividhavastrābharaṇavibhūṣaṇagandhamālāvilepanapānabhojyavividharasarasāgraparibhogāṃ paricarati. vividhaśayyāsanadhanadhānyakośakośāgāravivṛddhiṃ paricarati. yāvajjīvena cchāyānubaddhā bhaviṣyati. jīvitam api parityajati. yadi bhaginī tadā vividha-aiśvaryadivyavimānaparibhogām paricarati. yāvajjīvam upasthānaparicaryāṃ karoti.
analyzed: kāmarūpīm āvāhayitu kāmena lāja sarṣapa dadhi madhu ghṛta aktām gandha priyaṅgu aṣṭa sahasram juhuyāt karavīra kāṣṭha samidbhiḥ agni prajvālya kāmarūpī āgacchati yathākāma tā cārayati prakārāṇi vaktavyam mātā bhāryā bhaginī yadi mātā putra snehayā mahādhana dhānya paribhoga vivṛddhim saṃpādayati yāvajjīvam a vaikalpa tām saṃtiṣṭhati yadi bhāryām aneka vividha rati krīḍayā paribhogam paricarati vividha vastra ābharaṇa vibhūṣaṇa anu
